Demo: block management

Residents' requests, triaged in seconds

Your team stops reading, sorting and forwarding every resident email by hand. Each one is routed and answered as it arrives, emergencies first, so the same team can run more blocks.

A block manager's shared inbox on a Monday morning. Press the button: each email is sorted by kind and urgency, matched to its block and flat, routed to the right contractor or team, and answered. Chasers are linked to the job already open, so nobody books the same plumber twice.

Open Hallkeeper, the appA block manager's helpdesk, with this morning's inbox in it.

In production it reads your real inbox with your block list and contractor rota, and a person approves anything it is unsure of.

  • Read
  • Sort and score urgency
  • Match block and flat
  • Link chasers
  • Route
  • Answer

Try one of your own

Paste or write a resident's email. Use one of these blocks (Marlowe Court, Kestrel House, The Foundry, Albion Wharf) to see it matched.

Before and after, with your numbers

Example inputs. Change them to your own: how many requests a week, how long one takes to read, sort, log, route and answer by hand today, and how long a person needs to check the triaged version.

The audit measures your real figures before anything is built, and the build is measured against them.

What the real build adds

Your systems

Jobs raised in your property management system, contractors instructed from your rota, leaseholder records read rather than guessed.

Out of hours

Emergencies (water near electrics, a lift with someone in it, an alarm sounding) go to the on-call contractor at once, with a text to the duty manager.

After an acquisition

A newly bought book of blocks joins the same inbox and the same rules on day one, before its systems are merged.
